text.name: Iridescent Pearl
text.description:
{Iridescent Pearl}

Worn on a wrist, this item increases your Attack and Power skills by +5, and causes your Water spells to inflict an additional 25% damage.
text.event: A glimmering sheen catches your eye from atop your horse. Upon excavating the artifact, you find a pearl-adorned gauntlet filled with mystical power and place it around your wrist.
